items.title: Dark Reading Confidential: This Threat Hunter Helped Cops Bust Up An African Cybercrime Syndicate
items.description: Dark Reading Confidential Episode 15: Interpol relied on Will Thomas and team to help break up a sprawling cybercrime ring, leading to the arrest of 574 suspects, the recovery of more than $3 million, and the decryption of six malware variants. Here's his story.

items.title: IPVanish VPN for macOS Vulnerability Let Attackers Escalate Privilege and Execute Arbitrary Code
items.description: A critical privilege escalation vulnerability has been discovered in the IPVanish VPN application for macOS. This flaw allows any unprivileged local user to execute arbitrary code as root without requiring user interaction. The security failure completely bypasses macOS security features, including code signature verification, posing a severe risk to affected systems.​ Attack Chain and Execution…

items.title: Fake Laravel Packages on Packagist Deploy RAT on Windows, macOS, and Linux
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have flagged malicious Packagist PHP packages masquerading as Laravel utilities that act as a conduit for a cross-platform remote access trojan (RAT) that's functional on Windows, macOS, and Linux systems. The names of the packages are listed below - nhattuanbl/lara-helper (37 Downloads) nhattuanbl/simple-queue (29 Downloads) nhattuanbl/lara-swagger (49 Downloads)
